items.title: Joseph 'One Eyed Babe' Phillips Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: That's Frank and Doocy. Yeah. That's a tramp all black. Yeah. Frank and Doocy.

ctx.x: and he would run me out the hall. He used to play in that too. But I can't see. He had curly hair and nice looking. Oh.

What a little. You know, he didn't try to call him. That's Frank and Doocy. Yeah. That's what's up. That's a tramp all black. Yeah. Frank and Doocy. That was a slight tramp on you talking about. When you say good hair. That's all they used to call him.
